title: Update changed, move/rights-change reporting and rights docs for filenode-20
description: 566c2b6/686e240/020da7f, draft lines 287-307, 1070-1086: changed covers only non-per-user properties (per-user and inherited-rights changes need not bump it); a move reports descendants only when their inherited rights change, and as destroyed to users who lose visibility; created needs mayModifyContent; role change needs mayRename. Crate: changed doc says 'every mutation' (crate-jmap-filenode-types filenode.rs:273-279); MemoryBackend never sets changed (memory.rs:403, pre-existing gap); rights contract omits created and role (backend.rs:96-100, README.md:207-211). Keep following metadata-05 on metadata-only changes (see IETF bead on the filenode/metadata conflict).
notes: 2026-11-13 spec-sync batch 1: filenode-20 group NOT integrated (verify failed at b9e88191, branch worktree-wf_d9b28b7b-50b-9 kept unmerged). Work in 8482ce76, 319607ee, ed32af4b; no blocking problem found in this bead, it waits on the group. Open nit: MemoryBackend reports updatedProperties ["myRights"] for File/SymLink descendants on shareWith change.
close_reason: Done on main: 72f181a4 (set changed and report rights changes per -20), ecd91a3b (backend rights and patch docs), bda149e4 (MemoryBackend reports the whole moved subtree with updatedProperties [myRights] when a move changes the set of sharing ancestors).
